title: **The packaged binary is fixed at dependency version** — Node deployments use the version selected by `@vscode/ripgrep`; Python single-file runtimes copy that target-native version into the required `-rg` sidecar. An unsupported platform or...

attrs.text: **The packaged binary is fixed at dependency version** — Node deployments use the version selected by `@vscode/ripgrep`; Python single-file runtimes copy that target-native version into the required `-rg` sidecar. An unsupported platform or a corrupted installation fails with `SEARCH_FAILED`, while the Python runtime package rejects a missing sidecar before launch. Remote or virtual filesystems need a co-located workspace or another search consumer.
